response.feedback_interpretation: Historical labels support local, scaffold-dependent residual transfer. Diarylnitro and fluorinated thioether behavior remains substitution-sensitive; IPA effects transferred more clearly. Large stereochemical prediction gaps often collapsed or reversed. Low-center failures also occur outside silicon chemistry. Current centers remain MSE-trained point predictions, widths are uncalibrated, and coverage is a raw-gradient distance percentile. Residual sign matches do not establish mechanisms.
response.batch_rationale: All 4,018 candidates were compared globally across the 14 delivery pages. The 32 selections prioritize unresolved matched controls for nitro substitution, fluorinated thioethers, IPA, imidazole chains, dioxane functional groups, sulfonyl stereochemistry, and low-center enol esters. Remaining slots add stereopairs and chemically distinct donor-carbonyl, lactone, heteroaryl, fused-amine, and nitrogen-rich labels. No page or scaffold quotas were used.
